note: A synthetic client (Slice 129 worked example). Not a real company.
problem: A restaurant customer deposited $171,000 in cash last month across 19 deposits, each under $10,000.

answers.common.decision: Whether the activity is suspicious and whether to file a report; the investigations lead decides.

answers.common.materials: In the year before, their cash deposits averaged $36,000 a month. Their declared sales are about $60,000 a month.
answers.financial-crime.case: Cash deposit monitoring for business accounts under our anti-money laundering policy.
answers.financial-crime.decider: The investigations lead decides any finding and any regulatory filing.
